comments.text: Score combination exploration done; awaiting Ryan's decision (left open). No production change. Recommendation: Bayesian shrinkage per dimension, k=20, reader share capped at 0.4, ratings from profiles under 24h at weight 1/3, drop readerMinimum. Simulated on the 70 real Shipped items (editor composite sd 0.28): vs current blend the 5th-rating rank jump falls from 7.3 to 1.2; socks to put a mid-table item in the top 5 rise from 13 to 28 (96 at 1/3 weight); cost: slower to follow genuine reader disagreement (gap closure 0.36 vs 0.44 at 30 raters). Wilson on upvotes for Front rejected (ignores editors, split-half Spearman 0.17, overhyped item ranks 1 of 70). Rising and the 3-report Shipped stamp fall to 3 sock accounts whatever the formula; count only profiles older than 24h. Write-up and sim: Papyrus docs/score-combination.md (PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/561); Shipped summary PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Shipped-web/pull/42.
